coordinates: pixels, x to the right, y down, raw image coordinates of each frame. To remove camera drift use x - bg_dx, y - bg_dy (frame-0 scenery coordinates); columns bg_dx/bg_dy are in every track file.
summary: Handheld, nearly static camera on a sunny campus plaza (palm trees, sandstone building with arcade on the right, row of wooden bollards). A person (cream cap, white long-sleeve top, khaki cargo trousers) rides a dark grey/black electric kick scooter from left to right across the whole clip, side-on to the camera, from sunlit pavement into the shadow of the building. A second person (dark clothes, backpack) walks slowly to the right in the background beside the building and disappears behind a dark pillar.

camera.motion: handheld, slow smooth drift; no pan of significance
camera.note: shift = median displacement of 8 static background patches relative to frame 0 (template matching, subpixel). Patch disagreement grows to ~1.7 px by the end (tiny rotation/parallax). Compared with the rider's ~620 px travel the drift is ~1%, but subtract it for exact work.

objects.name: scooter_rider
objects.description: Person on electric kick scooter (rider + scooter treated as one moving object; scooter sub-points recorded separately). Rider: cream/beige cap, white long-sleeve top, khaki cargo trousers, white shoes. Scooter: dark grey/black, small rear wheel with fender, larger black front wheel, tall stem with handlebar.
objects.reference_point: cx, cy = centre of the clean bounding box (scooter rear tyre edge .. max(front tyre edge, handlebar), cap top .. wheel bottoms). Alternatives in the file: body_centroid (mask centroid above the wheels), rear_axle, front_axle, scooter_front_x (front tyre's leading edge), scooter_rear_x.
objects.direction: left to right, side-on to camera (motion almost purely horizontal; ground line y ~758-759 px throughout)

scooter_length_px.definition: horizontal distance from rear tyre's rear edge to front tyre's front edge (wheel to wheel, the scooter's overall length along the motion direction; handlebar sits above the front wheel and does not extend it)
scooter_length_px.early_frames_px: ~119-122 in frames 0-10, ~124 at frame 15 (apparent length grows while the rider moves from the left edge towards the image centre; checked by eye on 6x zooms)

rider_height_px.definition: cap top to ground (bottom of scooter wheels) = height_top_to_ground_px; the person stands on the deck (~10-12 px above ground), so person-only height is about 10-12 px less
rider_height_px.values: 205 px at frame 0 rising to 215 px at frame 57

objects.bbox_width_px: ~120 at frame 0, ~127 from frame 20 on (= scooter length; handlebar does not extend past the front wheel)
objects.occlusion: none: rider passes IN FRONT of bollard_3 (frames ~36-48) and bollard_4 (frames ~50-57) and the palm trunk/lamp post
objects.shadow: rider casts a ground shadow to the left/behind in the sunlit part (frames 0-~45); excluded from the box/scooter edges

objects.name: pedestrian_backpack
objects.description: Background pedestrian in dark clothing with a backpack, near the building arcade right of centre (x ~1270-1440, y ~570-675 px); small (~100 px tall).
objects.direction: walks slowly to the right (x 1290 -> 1437) along the building
objects.occlusion: frames 0-15 fully visible (head to feet, ~103 px tall); frames 16-49 legs hidden by bushes (occluded=1); frames 50-57 going behind a dark pillar/lamp post at x~1440 (occluded=2, only a sliver visible, track meaningless for position)

static_objects.note: positions in frame-0 image coords (pixels), read on 4x zooms of the median background, +-1.5 px. Bollards are wooden posts with a red band near the top; numbered left to right.

bollard_2.where: left, just behind (left of) the rider at frame 0

bollard_3.where: left of centre, sunlit, rider passes in front at frames ~36-48

bollard_4.where: centre, in shade, rider in front of it at end

bollard_7.where: right, closer to camera (on a different, nearer line)

white_post.where: white bollard with red band, right, on base plate, closer to camera

static_objects.bollard_row_note: bollards 1-6 stand on one line roughly parallel to the image plane at about the rider's depth (their bottoms y 734-756, the rider's ground line y ~758, slightly nearer); bollards 7, white_post, 8 are on a diagonal line receding towards the camera on the right.

golf_carts.note: two parked white utility carts at the far end of the walkway by the building, static

static_objects.building: sandstone building with red tile roof and arcade, right half of frame (x > 1145); windows at ~1245-1285 and 1318-1357, y 335-395
static_objects.palm_trees: large palm left (trunk x ~460-530, y 290-690), large palm right in front of building (trunk x ~1440-1530), several distant palms
static_objects.lamp_posts: dark pole x ~535-555 (y 270-690); small lamps at x ~618, 678
static_objects.ground: asphalt road in foreground, mostly in the building's shadow (diagonal shadow edge from ~x 480,y 780 up-right); drainage grate strip y ~740 from x ~780 to 1350; faint yellow crossing marks y ~800 x 1000-1600; sunlit pale pavement behind the bollards

events.event: rider already moving at frame 0 and keeps moving right to the last frame (no start/stop, no direction change)
rider's front wheel reaches the building's shadow on the ground (lighting change, not a physical event)
rider passes in front of bollard_3 (overlap in x)
rider starts overlapping bollard_4 (in front of it)
pedestrian goes behind dark pillar at x~1440

files.tracks/camera_shift.csv: per-frame background shift relative to frame 0
files.scripts/: all measurement scripts (run in order: camera_shift, build_bg, track (exploratory), track_wheels, wheel_edges, assemble, static_objects)
